note: Elements are [a,b] = a + b*t with t^2 = nr (mod p). g is a generator of GF(p^2)* and y = g^x. Recover x, then flag = AES-256-GCM decrypt of (nonce||ct||tag)=sealed_flag_hex with key=SHA256(b'zsctf-chorrivest|key|'+ascii(decimal(x))) and nonce=SHA256(b'zsctf-chorrivest|nonce|'+ascii(decimal(x)))[:12].
